title: Better shulker Recipe
description: A better shulker recipe for the forgetful people!
body:
Do you also forget to bring wood to then end or do you just want an easier recipe for shulker boxes? then this mod is perfect for you!


## You can craft them from your inventory

![Crafting A shulker from your inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/449da8f061851c13bee55d33f12dfac8ef71048e.png)

## And you can put the shulker shell and chest anywhere in the crafting grid
![Custom craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0123cd5daec811821456c6795764c893f475dae3.png)
